name: @ant/ide
description: ANT IDE Server - using Docker openvscode-server

scripts.predev: docker ps -a | grep ant-openvscode && (docker stop ant-openvscode; docker rm ant-openvscode) || true
scripts.dev: docker run -d --name ant-openvscode -p 4400:3000 -v "$HOME:/workspace:cached" gitpod/openvscode-server && echo '✅ OpenVSCode Server started on http://localhost:4400'
scripts.stop: docker stop ant-openvscode && docker rm ant-openvscode
scripts.build: echo 'No build step required for Docker-based IDE'
